summary.key_theme: AI 產品強勁成長與企業採用率提升，帶動分析師調升目標價與市場樂觀情緒。

bullish.title: ServiceNow Rallies 43% in Three Months as AI Contract Value Tops $1 Billion
bullish.reason: AI 合約價值突破 10 億美元大關，顯示其 AI Workflow Factory 產品在全球市場的強勁變現能力。

bullish.title: ServiceNow gets Street-high $266 price target as AI adoption boosts growth outlook
bullish.reason: 分析師給出華爾街最高目標價 266 美元，反映市場對其 AI 驅動成長前景的高度信心。

bullish.title: Truist Securities Maintains Buy on ServiceNow, Raises Price Target to $180
bullish.reason: Truist Securities 維持買入評級並調升目標價，顯示機構投資人對其長期獲利能力的認可。

bullish.title: ServiceNow Announces Updates For Governance, Security Across Its AI Offering With Nvidia
bullish.reason: 與 Nvidia 深度合作強化 AI 治理與安全性，提升了企業級客戶對其平台的信任度與競爭門檻。

bullish.title: These 2 software stocks are new Top Picks at BMO
bullish.reason: BMO Capital Markets 將 ServiceNow 列為首選股，進一步強化了市場對該股的買入動能。

bearish.title: ServiceNow Research Study Warns Security Leaders: Ungoverned Agentic AI Exposure Is Compounding Inside Enterprises
bearish.reason: 公司發布研究報告指出企業內部 AI 治理不足的風險，雖旨在推廣治理工具，但亦凸顯了 AI 部署的潛在安全隱憂。

bearish.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Needs Stronger Cash Flow to Support Its AI Expansion
bearish.reason: 指出 AI 擴張帶來的平台成本上升，強調公司需更強勁的現金流以支撐長期資本支出。

neutral.title: ServiceNow's Quarterly Earnings Preview: What You Need to Know
neutral.reason: 僅為財報發布前的市場預期整理，未包含具體利多或利空資訊。

neutral.title: Here is What to Know Beyond Why ServiceNow, Inc. (NOW) is a Trending Stock
neutral.reason: 針對股價趨勢的技術性與基本面事實整理，屬於中性市場觀察。
